problem: Ticket RSH-579 asks what Helix agents can do with the CLI: can they create tickets, look up other tickets, post comments, and use inspect for production logs/database? There is reported confusion about prod vs staging, and a concern from RSH-534 that agents may only have read-only CLI access.

files.why: Main CLI entrypoint and command router. All 10 top-level commands dispatched here: login, token, inspect, comments, preview, library, org, tickets, skill, update.
Tickets subcommand router. Dispatches: list, latest, get, create, update-description, rerun, continue, artifacts, artifact, bundle. Both read and write commands present.
Ticket creation implementation. POST /api/tickets with basePath '/api'. Requires --title, --description/--description-file, --repos. Supports --mode, --after, --reference, --implement-from.
Ticket listing. GET /api/tickets with basePath '/api'. Supports --search, --user, --status, --status-not-in, --archived, --sprint, --json.
Comments subcommand router. Dispatches: list, post. Both read and write.
Comment posting implementation. POST /api/tickets/{ticketId}/comments with basePath '/api'.
Inspect subcommand router. Dispatches: repos, db, logs, api. All read-only operations.

Configuration loading. Env var priority: HELIX_API_KEY > HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN > HELIX_INSPECT_API_KEY for token; HELIX_URL > HELIX_INSPECT_BASE_URL > HELIX_INSPECT_URL for URL. Falls back to ~/.hlx/config.json multi-org format.
HTTP client. Default basePath is '/api/inspect'. Token type detection: hxi_ prefix uses X-API-Key header, otherwise Bearer. Sends X-Helix-Org-ID for hxi_ keys with orgId.
Ticket reference resolver. Uses HELIX_TICKET_ID env var or --ticket flag. Fetches ticket list via /api/tickets to resolve short IDs and numeric references.
Repository resolver for --repos flag in ticket create. Fetches from /api/inspect/repositories (default basePath '/api/inspect'). Supports name, ID, and partial matching.
Ticket rerun command. POST /api/tickets/{ticketId}/rerun.
Ticket continue command. POST /api/tickets/{ticketId}/rerun with continuationContext body.
Ticket description update command. PATCH /api/tickets/{ticketId} with description body.
Library subcommand router. Dispatches: list, show, comments (list, post). Post supports section ratings.
Bundled skill documentation that agents see. Documents all commands including write operations (tickets create, comments post). Contains workflow steps and guardrails.
Full CLI command reference distributed to agents via skill install.
Package metadata. Name: @projectxinnovation/helix-cli v1.3.4. Binary: hlx. Scripts: build (tsc), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (tsc && node --test). ESM, Node >=18.
Skill management: show (prints SKILL.md) and install (copies skill-content to agent skills directory).
Login command. Browser-based OAuth flow or manual API key entry.
Token add command. Direct token configuration without browser flow.

facts: CLI version 1.3.4 has both read and write commands: tickets create, tickets update-description, tickets rerun, tickets continue, comments post, library comments post.
All ticket CRUD commands (create, list, get, etc.) use basePath '/api' - not '/api/inspect'.
Config loading checks env vars in order: HELIX_API_KEY > HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN > HELIX_INSPECT_API_KEY for the token. All resolve to the same HxConfig.apiKey field.
The env var HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN is a legacy alias that provides the same access as HELIX_API_KEY - no read-only restriction in CLI code.
hxi_ prefixed tokens use X-API-Key header; other tokens use Bearer Authorization header (src/lib/http.ts:53-57).
The skill documentation (SKILL.md) explicitly lists ticket creation in the workflow: step 6 says 'Create a ticket: hlx tickets create --title ... --repos ... --description ...'
Ticket resolve uses HELIX_TICKET_ID env var first, then --ticket flag, then positional arg (src/lib/resolve-ticket.ts:17-31).
Repository resolution for --repos in 'tickets create' calls /api/inspect/repositories (default basePath), not /api/repositories.
CLI configuration is stored at ~/.hlx/config.json with multi-org support (orgs array + currentOrg pointer).
Production logs confirm POST /api/tickets 201 (ticket creation) succeeds - observed at 2026-05-22T22:45:22Z for this ticket.
All 10 active production API keys have empty repos arrays (no repository scoping = full access to all inspection and API endpoints).
The CLI has no built-in read-only mode or permission restriction - all auth is delegated to the server.
unknowns: Whether the HELIX_INSPECT_TOKEN env var name causes agents to believe they only have inspection/read-only access, leading to them not attempting write operations.
Whether agents in RSH-534 failed to create tickets due to CLI code issues, auth issues, or simply not knowing the commands exist.
Whether the agent skill installation (hlx skill install) is consistently available in all agent sandbox environments.
Whether agents receive clear guidance about which environment (prod vs staging) their configured token targets - the env var name alone does not indicate environment.
What specific errors, if any, agents encountered in RSH-534 when attempting ticket creation via CLI.
Whether the 10,000-char description cap (server-enforced) could silently cause failures for agent-generated ticket descriptions.
